title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Schedule of Waiting-Week Earnings Disregard Shares by Household
content:
For a waiting-week value on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the disregard share — the share of the weekly benefit amount that sets the week's earnings disregard, rounded to the cent — follows the dependents on record on the claim and whether the week valued reports earnings.

| Dependents on record | Week valued reports earnings (above zero) | Disregard share |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | Yes | 0.4 (the family share) |
| None | Yes | 0.35 (the single share) |
| Any | No | The program's disregard share |

Any other waiting-week value uses the program's disregard share.

### Hypothetical figures (weekly benefit amount 346.00)

| Dependents | Earnings in the week | Disregard |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 200.00 | 0.4 times 346.00, that is 138.40 |
| 0 | 200.00 | 0.35 times 346.00, that is 121.10 |
| 2 | 0.00 | The program's share times 346.00 |
